features: Mini Portable Travel Oven: The Alfredx mini personal portable oven can not only cook raw food, but also heat leftovers. This is a slow cooker, no turntable or timer, this portable microwave can heat most foods in about 1-2 hours (freezer meals are longer), but you can take it anywhere.

Larger Space ：11.5’’ x 9.1’’ x 5.5’’ , lightweight, portable and convenient.Ultra-high speed acceleration, 1.5 hours for meals Leading other companies' similar products.Heating way-compatible with most flat-bottom, sealable containers including glass, plastic, Tupperware, metal, aluminum foil, and cardboard.

Reheat Food & Cook: No need to worry about food burning and blurring. Keep the temperature between 140°F and 230°F and it will automatically cycle. You don't have to worry about time settings and temperature. This is a slow cooker, so it is not overcooked.

Mealtime Freedom: How much time would you save if you could cook a meal without worrying about setting a timer, adjusting the temperature, or stirring your food while working? Unlike any other appliance, the Alfredx fast oven removes the time constraints from your meal.

Take It Anywhere: Put this personal slow cookers in your backpack and you will not even feel its weight, can be taken through railway, airport and metro security. Great choice for truck driver, railway worker, flight attendant, office worker, patrolman, nurse and more.
